summary: The regex-lite parser could produce a very deeply nested Hir value beyond the configured nested limit. This was caused by repetition operators adding nested structures to the Hir without corresponding recursive calls in the parser. The fix adds a check_hir_nesting() function that validates the depth of the final Hir value after parsing completes, and changes parse() to call parse_inner() and then check the nesting depth before returning. Without this check, deeply nested patterns like '.{asterisk}{asterisk}...' (32768 asterisks) would cause stack overflow in the Thompson NFA compiler when it recursively traverses the Hir.
